text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — I've submitted my resignation to Priya. My last day will be 2026-05-01. Happy to do handoffs over the next two weeks. Also unclear on benefits cutoff and COBRA options — can someone confirm?

Devon R: Thanks for the heads up, Maya. Sorry to see you go. Can you DM me your preferred exit interview slot? We'll start the offboarding checklist. @hr-bot can you kick off COBRA/benefits flow for @Maya Chen? :handshake:

hr-bot: Automated Notice: Offboarding checklist created for Maya Chen (UID: rwd-0824). Benefits end date set to 2026-05-01. COBRA election window: 60 days from 2026-05-02. Payroll: final paycheck processing to be initiated on separation date.

Devon R: To clarify — benefits are active through last day (2026-05-01). COBRA notice will be mailed in 3 business days from separation. If Maya elects COBRA, coverage is retroactive to 2026-05-02. We'll also confirm 401(k) distribution options with Fidelity.

Sofia Iqbal: @Maya Chen IT here. Please drop your laptop in the FedEx dropbox at HQ or ship using prepaid label we'll generate. I'll open the asset-return ticket and tag @IT-ops for access removal. Please send serial: LTP-04567.

Maya Chen: Thanks — serial is LTP-04567. Preference is to ship; please send label.

Devon R: @Priya S can you confirm if there are any org-specific access handoffs? Reminder: we'll revoke keys on last day 23:59 UTC; IT will coordinate exact timing.

Priya S: We'll pair Maya with Leo for the handover on 2026-04-22 and 2026-04-29. No outstanding client access beyond the one shared vault; I'll add Leo to the vault today.

Sofia Iqbal: Asset ticket created: #IT-2048. Prepaid label sent to Maya's personal email. Access revocation scheduled for 2026-05-01 23:59 UTC. We'll snapshot account for audit before removal.

Devon R: Exit interview — options: 30-min 1:1 with People Ops or written form. Maya, which do you prefer?

Maya Chen: I'll do the 30-min call. Any prep docs I should look at?

Devon R: No prep needed. I'll send calendar invite for 2026-04-26 10:00 PT. Also noted for payroll — final comp includes payout for unused PTO per policy.

Payroll Team: FYI — final payout will include accrued vacation (per policy) and pro-rated bonus through separation. Allow one pay cycle for processing.

Devon R: Closing notes: We'll send the COBRA packet and separation letter to your personal email on file within 3 business days of separation. If you want anything earlier, DM me. Thanks Maya — appreciate the transition help and we'll follow up on any outstanding items.
